items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: We used to play for the Toine Verand.

ctx.x: any of those Germans in? Yeah, we played German music. We used to play for the Toine Verand. Toine his heart. That was all German music. Deiz Lene Aries Augustine ! Alley, Harlow, Rosser Schimmel Schmoll, all kind of German pieces. I used to do them doito. They used to have fine liver sausage. And also they had limboiga cheese. They had two kinds of bread. had what they called black bread. And they had French loaf. But when I come in and see the whole stuff packed on the table I get myself a liver sausage and get…
Did they have many piano players in those days? They had a few.
